mentions.name: probed.chat
mentions.description: A chat platform for founders, creators, and small teams to talk directly to their users, replacing email and ticket queues with real-time conversations and helping build a community around a product.
mentions.problem: Community Discords don't scale for support or community-driven product growth.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building https://probed.chat!

A chat platform for founders, creators, and small teams to talk directly to their users! No more email or ticket queues. Build a real community around what you make.
